content.value_statement: Creators need consistent bilingual picture books with age-aware learning goals. This skill builds story pages, Chinese-English text, and image prompts from structured choices.
actual_capabilities: Generates Chinese-English picture book pages with story text, pinyin, and learning points.
Supports 18 visual styles, including watercolor, clay, paper-cut, ink, nianhua, and tech.
Uses 12 core scenes and can match expanded scenes to supported scene rules.
Adapts page count, vocabulary, and learning objectives for ages 3 to 12.
Maintains character anchors across pages with Character Consistency Lock Protocol markers.
Produces banana nano image prompts with style, scene, character, and watermark-prevention guidance.
limitations: It prepares stories and prompts, but it does not render final images.
Best consistency comes from the configured characters, scenes, and style lists.
Educational content needs human review before classroom, publishing, or commercial use.
Optional shell scripts are documentation utilities and are not part of normal story generation.

use_cases.title: Draft Classroom Reading Material
use_cases.description: Create short bilingual stories with age-appropriate learning points and simple image prompt guidance.

use_cases.title: Develop Family Story Ideas
use_cases.description: Turn a child, scene, and theme into a structured picture book concept with consistent characters.

use_cases.title: Prepare Illustrated Book Prompts
use_cases.description: Generate page-by-page visual prompts that keep character appearance stable across an image series.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Book
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one style, scene, and age.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a watercolor meadow picture book for age 5. Use the default character and make it three pages.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Learning Goal
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request that guides the educational focus.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a clay forest picture book for age 7 with five pages. Focus on observation, counting, and kindness.

prompt_templates.title: Use Family Characters
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with multiple characters and a theme.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a nianhua kitchen story for age 6 with Yueyue and grandma. Use a warm family theme and include pinyin.

prompt_templates.title: Control Story Mood and Consistency
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with style, pacing, character, and consistency needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a seven-page ink-line courtyard story for age 9 with Xiaoming. Use a curious mood, gentle pacing, and strict character consistency.

output_examples.input: watercolor meadow age 4 with the default character
output_examples.output: A short bilingual meadow story with simple vocabulary, one Chinese learning character, pinyin, and a soft watercolor image prompt.

output_examples.input: clay forest age 8 with five pages and a discovery theme
output: A five-page story arc with beginning, middle, and ending scenes.
Each page includes Chinese and English story text, a learning point, and a clay-style banana nano prompt.
Character anchors repeat across pages to preserve visual continuity.

output_examples.input: nianhua kitchen age 10 with Xiaoming and grandma
output_examples.output: A culturally styled family story with bilingual text, kitchen learning details, and page prompts using nianhua visual guidance.

best_practices: Start with a supported style, scene, target age, and desired page count.
Choose one learning goal per page so the story stays clear for children.
Review all generated text and image prompts before sharing with children or image tools.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for unsupported age ranges or adult themes.
Do not mix many visual styles in one short story unless you want a fragmented look.
Do not use generated prompts as final educational or publishing material without review.

faq.question: Does this skill generate final images?
faq.answer: No. It creates story text and image prompts for a separate image generator such as banana nano.

faq.question: Which languages does it support?
faq.answer: It focuses on Chinese-English bilingual stories and can include pinyin and learning characters.

faq.question: What ages are supported?
faq.answer: The built-in age system supports children from 3 to 12 years old.

faq.question: Can I use my own character?
faq.answer: The skill works best with configured characters. It includes guidance for character type detection and extension.

faq.question: Can it handle Chinese cultural styles?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes ink, ink-line, nianhua, porcelain, and shadow-puppet style guidance.

faq.question: Is the output ready for publication?
faq.answer: No. Treat the output as a draft and review language, safety, accuracy, and image rights before publication.
